description: Table 3 in the paper is rendered as a single image-only table with seven columns and three data rows; it contains no plots, micrographs or scale bars. The header reads "Specimen", "σ₀/MPa", "σ_g/MPa", "σ_d/MPa", "σ_Orowan/MPa", "σ_y/MPa" and "Actual value /MPa", i.e. matrix/friction stress, grain-boundary strengthening, dislocation strengthening, Orowan (precipitation) strengthening, the theoretical superimposed yield strength σ_y, and the measured yield strength. The three specimens are the annealed conditions AN750, AN800 and AN850. Every specimen has σ₀ = 220 MPa; σ_g decreases from 264 MPa (AN750) to 256 MPa (AN800) then rises to 292 MPa (AN850); σ_d rises strongly from 263 MPa (AN750) to 459 MPa (AN800) before falling to 414 MPa (AN850); σ_Orowan is 0 for all three specimens, so Orowan strengthening contributes nothing in this steel. The theoretical σ_y values are 747, 935 and 926 MPa, against actual values of 709, 968 and 964 MPa — the model underestimates AN750 by 38 MPa and overestimates AN800 and AN850 by 33 and 38 MPa respectively. The table therefore quantifies the per-mechanism breakdown that produces the near-plateau yield strength between AN800 and AN850, and shows that dislocation strengthening dominates the difference between AN750 and the two higher-temperature anneals.

subfigures.description: Single image-rendered table with columns Specimen, σ₀/MPa, σ_g/MPa, σ_d/MPa, σ_Orowan/MPa, σ_y/MPa, Actual value /MPa and rows AN750 (220, 264, 263, 0, 747, 709), AN800 (220, 256, 459, 0, 935, 968), AN850 (220, 292, 414, 0, 926, 964).

observations.observation: Table 3 contains three specimens labelled AN750, AN800 and AN850.
The table columns are σ₀/MPa, σ_g/MPa, σ_d/MPa, σ_Orowan/MPa, σ_y/MPa and Actual value /MPa beside the Specimen column.
σ₀ (friction/matrix stress) is 220 MPa for all three specimens, AN750, AN800 and AN850.
σ_d (dislocation strengthening) is 263 MPa for AN750, 459 MPa for AN800 and 414 MPa for AN850.
σ_g (grain-boundary strengthening) is 264 MPa for AN750, 256 MPa for AN800 and 292 MPa for AN850.
σ_Orowan is 0 MPa for all three specimens, indicating no Orowan strengthening contribution.
The theoretical yield strength σ_y is 747 MPa (AN750), 935 MPa (AN800) and 926 MPa (AN850).
The actual yield strength is 709 MPa (AN750), 968 MPa (AN800) and 964 MPa (AN850).
The theoretical σ_y underestimates AN750 (747 vs 709 MPa) and overestimates AN800 and AN850 (935 vs 968 MPa; 926 vs 964 MPa).
Table 3 shows the contribution of different strengthening mechanisms to the theoretical strengthening and the actual YS values.
The dislocation strengthening contributions of AN750, AN800 and AN850 are 263 MPa, 459 MPa and 414 MPa, respectively.
